purpose: Exact independent variable for B1 D2: repository-level Workflow Execution Protection applied between positive controls and negative probes.

event_rule.required_ui_semantic: Saved event rule visibly permits pull_request_target and does not permit pull_request or push.
event_rule.unlisted_event_semantics: GitHub documents an allow list but only examples of event names. Select only pull_request_target. B1 evidence is claimed only for pull_request and push, the event classes actually probed.

actor_rule.meaning: No actor restriction is added; default write-capable trigger permission remains. Accepted only while the single-operator premise is positively re-proven.
actor_rule.if_UI_cannot_express_exact_state: STOP_AND_REDESIGN; do not add an actor rule as an approximation and do not proceed to D2.

D1_read_only_representability_observatio.observation: Open the repository Actions Policies configuration surface without saving any change. Record whether the intended event-rule state can carry zero actor rules and whether the UI's save action is visibly available/enabled for that exact draft state. Do not activate the save action.
D1_read_only_representability_observatio.satisfied_only_if: The exact draft state visibly carries zero actor rules and the save action is available/enabled without requiring an actor rule.

accepted_collaborators.primary: Enumerate current repository collaborators through the GitHub API and record effective permission/capability sufficient to identify every write-capable identity.
accepted_collaborators.fallback: If the API cannot prove the complete accepted-collaborator set, use the repository Collaborators UI as the fallback evidence surface.

pending_invitations.accepted_result: No pending invitation capable of becoming an additional write-capable identity during the experiment.

single_operator_evidence.D2_immediate_recheck: Immediately before the D2 WEP mutation, repeat both accepted-collaborator enumeration and pending-invitation observation. Any failure, unobservability, drift or additional write-capable identity => STOP.

actor_rule.collaborator_change_rule: Any additional write-capable identity, or inability to prove the single-operator premise, reopens this design before mutation.

bypass.if_no_bypass_surface_exists: record INAPPLICABLE_NOT_SATISFIED; do not infer universal no-bypass

target_encoding.rule: Use repository-level Actions Policies UI; do not substitute organization/custom-property targeting.

field_by_field_D2_acceptance: single-operator collaborator/invitation recheck SATISFIED immediately before mutation
bypass present-and-empty if exposed otherwise INAPPLICABLE_NOT_SATISFIED

capture_before_mutation: accepted-collaborator enumeration surface, raw result and interpreted write-capable identities
pending-invitation surface observability and raw result
prestate_and_conditional_restore.future_D2_restore_candidate: Pre-authorize only exact restoration of captured WEP prestate for exact D2 treatment object after verified evidence export.
prestate_and_conditional_restore.if_export_incomplete: DO_NOT_RESTORE; STOP with state in place.

claims_forbidden: all unlisted event classes proven blocked
actor_rules=[] representability proven before D1 observation
single-operator premise proven when collaborator or invitation enumeration is unavailable
